imports a .txt file of duration data, converts the duration variable to hh:mm:ss (hms) format, and exports the resulting data to an rda file.

Source: R/fls_tags_importer.R
fls_tags_importer.Rd

fls_tags_importer is used to import a .txt file of duration data generated with kid3 audio tagger (https://kid3.kde.org/)

Usage

fls_tags_importer(myfilename = NULL)

Arguments

myfilename

the full path and filename of the file to be imported and converted.

Value

A data frame of the imported tag data (track, artist, album, name, duration), with duration parsed into an hms Period and seconds/minutes columns added.

Details

fls_tags_importer

Examples

fls_tags_importer(myfilename = system.file("extdata", "fls_tags.txt", package = "Repeatr"))
